assertion_review.condition: A leaf has differing integer/boolean values, a different finite mask, or relative continuous error above 1e-12.
assertion_review.mutation: Carry prior axis/flux/area/edge/coefficient/form values; stale-edge mutation actually fails all three shifted cases.

assertion_review.condition: The stable shifted read rebuilds, the untracked read does not rebuild, either read is invalid, selected or normal cells differ, or fresh edge intervals show no motion.
assertion_review.mutation: Always rebuild, keep stale continuous geometry, or alter carried ownership; the explicit motion assertion prevents unchanged-state equality from being counted.

assertion_review.condition: A moved tracked cell does not report a rebuild or exactly one counter increment, or rebuilt geometry differs from an independent untracked call.
assertion_review.mutation: Ignore the tracked-cell change or reuse the preceding read.

assertion_review.condition: An unchanged carried call rebuilds, a requested certificate lacks the rebuilt flag, or certified geometry differs from fresh.
assertion_review.mutation: Removing certification entirely fails the flag assertion; a flag-only bypass survives, as recorded in the first finding.

assertion_review.condition: The solver omits its certificate callback, never requests it, requests it inconsistently on the converging valid toy path, accepts an invalid certificate, or returns a non-fresh incumbent at the cap.
assertion_review.input_dependence: certificate_valid is a supplied mock validity flag, but convergence is computed by the real solver; ignoring validity makes the False arm fail, so convergence==certificate_valid is not a tautology; rebuilt in the mock is derived from requested and tests propagation rather than execution of the real full-read branch.
assertion_review.mutation: Remove the solve certificate callback, omit validity from convergence, or remove terminal fresh-read fallback.

assertion_review.condition: The displacement no longer preserves stationary cells, changed represented cells do not request rebuilding, the result fails to rebuild, or rebuilt geometry differs from fresh.
assertion_review.mutation: Remove represented_saddle_cells from rebuild_needed; the positive in-cell displacement would stop forcing a full read.

assertion_review.condition: Unmodified fragment incidence is refused or zeroed edge intervals are accepted.
assertion_review.mutation: Make carried_decision_changed always false; the zeroed-interval refusal becomes false.

assertion_review.condition: Missing exit/summary, unrecognised known failing control, a failed real arm, wrong base revision, different product bytes at a recorded head, added failure IDs, or unexpected pass totals.
assertion_review.mutation: Supply a truncated log, changed source revision, or known failing stale-edge receipt; source positive parser control actually observes three failure IDs.

assertion_review.condition: Unconverged common inputs or solve, wrong width/device/dtype, empty device trace, census missing initial full reads or lane divisibility, invalid terminal full read, or fresh residual above 1e-10.
assertion_review.mutation: Run on the wrong device, suppress callbacks, lose convergence or return a stale terminal state; device measurements remain deferred so these guards have not all been executed at the final revision.

assertion_review.condition: Incomplete parent or process, wrong device/row keys/count/hash, mismatched paired rows, nonfinite/out-of-budget precision, invalid residual/census, or missing stream inputs.
assertion_review.mutation: Feed the actually timed-out parent ending EXIT=0 without the all-arms marker; source incomplete-receipt-refusal.log records AssertionError: paired job did not finish all arms.

The new limited wall_contact winner check has no focused changed-contact regression: all added real-geometry tracking cases use diverted_case, so dropping wall_stable from validity could survive the added tests even though limited contact ownership must trigger rebuilding.
